inventoryoverlay.config.title: Inventory Overlay Config
inventoryoverlay.config.horizontalAnchor: The horizontal edge of the screen the overlay is anchored to.
inventoryoverlay.config.verticalAnchor.t: The vertical edge of the screen the overlay is anchored to.
inventoryoverlay.config.xOffset.tooltip:
Horizontal offset from the anchor point in pixels.

Range: -500 to 500
inventoryoverlay.config.yOffset.tooltip:
Vertical offset from the anchor point in pixels.

Range: -500 to 500
inventoryoverlay.config.containerAlphaPe:
Transparency of the overlay background.

0% = fully transparent
100% = fully opaque
inventoryoverlay.config.wipeEffectEnable: Enables a wipe animation when new items enter empty slots.
inventoryoverlay.config.textureMode.tool:
Vanilla uses the base game texture.

Custom uses the active resource pack.
